question_text: From your reading of the above passage, fill in the blanks
stimulus: with suitable words. Use one word only in each blank. 1×5=5 Though Stephen Hawking can't move and speak, he (a)  at Cambridge University. Even he (b)  his research. He is doing everything with the (c)  of a computer. He is (d)  for his book "A brief History of Time". This book has earned him (e) .
guide_solution: Filling in gaps without clues (a) studied; (b) continues; (c) help; (d) famous; (e) reputaion
